risks.reasoning: For the six months ended June 30, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash generated from operating activities of RMB447,159 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB180,855 thousand. Because net cash from operating activities is positive, the frozen protocol rule treats the period as having no operating cash burn.

The accountants' report shows profits of RMB658,099 thousand, RMB818,764 thousand, RMB826,729 thousand and RMB357,586 thousand for 2019, 2020, 2021 and H1 2021 respectively, and a loss of RMB260,830 thousand for H1 2022 driven by non-cash share-based payments related to Pre-IPO Investments. Only one comparable loss period exists, which does not meet the frozen two-period medium or three-period high threshold.

Revenue decreased from RMB2,302,842 thousand in H1 2021 to RMB2,260,529 thousand in H1 2022, a decrease of approximately 1.84%. The decline is below zero but above the -20% high threshold, so the frozen medium revenue-growth threshold is triggered.

For H1 2022, the five largest customers accounted for approximately 6.2% of revenue. Because the top-five aggregate is below the frozen medium threshold of 60%, the largest customer must also be below 6.2% and therefore below the 30% medium threshold. The risk is rejected.

For H1 2022, the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 29.6% of total purchases in relation to production. Because the top-five aggregate is below the frozen medium threshold of 60%, the largest supplier must also be below 29.6% and therefore below the 30% medium threshold. The risk is rejected.

The Pre-IPO Investors were granted special rights including right of first refusal, right of co-sale, preemptive right, and information and inspection rights. No redemption right is disclosed, and the special rights will terminate upon completion of the initial public offering with no redemption mechanism.

The formal Legal Proceedings and Compliance section states that the Group was not a party to any material legal, arbitral or administrative proceedings with a material adverse effect during the Track Record Period and up to the Latest Practicable Date. Historical social insurance and housing provident fund shortfalls were fully provisioned and disclosed, with no material pending enforcement identified.

The Group is an established spicy snack food manufacturer and distributor with substantial revenue from seasoned flour products, vegetable products and bean-based products throughout the Track Record Period. Its core products are fully commercialized and revenue-generating.
